name: w64devkit
description_en: Portable C and C++ Development Kit for x64 (and x86) Windows
readme_excerpt: Portable C, C++, and Fortran Development Kit for x64 and x86 Windows [w64devkit][] is a Dockerfile that builds from source a small, portable development suite for creating C and C++ applications on and for x86 and x64 Windows. See "Releases" for pre-built, ready-to-use kits. Included tools: [Mingw-w64 GCC][w64] : compilers, linker, assembler [GDB][gdb] : debugger [GNU Make][make] : standard build tool [CMake][cmake] with [Ninja][ninja] and [a debugger][dcmake] : build system [busybox-w32][bb] :…
